name: participant-screener-builder
description: Builds screener surveys that recruit the right research participants, part of the Design Thinking Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run participant-screener-builder", "write a screener", "who should we recruit", "help me find the right interviewees", or recruitment is starting and "eight users" needs to become eight specific kinds of person. Use it even for "we need people to talk to".
